messages:
Ana Rivera: Quick sync — CloudScale marketplace listing + joint post need to go live same time as our Redwood landing. What launch window can ops support?
Mike Chen: Ops prefers 09:00-11:00 UTC so EU/US overlap covered. Any partner constraints? @CloudScale - Priya
CloudScale - Priya: 09:00-11:00 UTC okay. We need embargo lifted at 08:45 UTC so press has a small buffer.
Julie Park: Design needs final hero art + 2 screenshots by EOD tomorrow. @Mike can you confirm handoff path and time?
Mike Chen: Files will be uploaded to drive by 18:00 PT: https://drive.redwood.co/marketplace/partners/cloudscale/assets
Tom Reilly: Drafting ops timeline (short):
```
07:00 UTC - infra preflight (DNS + certs)
07:30 UTC - internal readiness huddle (15m)
08:15 UTC - decrease DNS TTL + CDN prewarm
08:45 UTC - embargo lift -> press release distribution
09:00 UTC - publish landing + marketplace listing
09:05 UTC - basic smoke tests (signup, billing ping, market API)
09:30 UTC - escalate if any regressions
```
Sree Nandakumar: Note: SI partner EdgeWorks needs API keys rotated and a test tenant provisioned before 07:30 UTC. Tom, can infra confirm provisioning by then?
Tom Reilly: Yes, infra will provision by 07:00 UTC. I'll paste provisioning logs into the runbook channel once done.
Ana Rivera: Who will own final blog copy and partner quote? We have PR draft v2 in hackmd but need final approval and a 1-2 sentence partner quote.
Julie Park: I'll own the blog wrap. @CloudScale - Priya please provide a 30-40 word quote by EOD PT. Also locking hero CTA: "Try CloudScale on Redwood — Deploy in minutes."
CloudScale - Priya: Quote confirmed — sending by 17:00 PT. CTA copy good.
Mike Chen: Proposed canonical URLs: /cloudscale for landing and /partners/cloudscale for marketplace listing. Approve?
Ana Rivera: Approve. Tom, ensure redirects and GA/UTM templates included.
Tom Reilly: Will add redirect rules and UTM params to the runbook. Also will prewarm CDN with short TTL an hour before publish.
Sree Nandakumar: Rollback plan (to include in runbook) — draft snippet:
```
1) Repoint /partners/cloudscale -> hold page (static)
2) Call marketplace API to revert listing: POST /v1/private/listings/{id}/revert
3) Announce rollback in #partners and open incident channel if >5% errors
```
Mike Chen: Need launch-day coverage: 2 infra, 1 comms, 1 partner PM during 09:00-11:00 UTC. Volunteers?
Julie Park: I'll cover comms 08:30-10:30 UTC.
Tom Reilly: I'll be infra primary 07:30-09:30 UTC, then handoff to Sree.
Sree Nandakumar: Taking infra secondary 09:30-11:30 UTC.
Ana Rivera: @Mike please add these people to the calendar invite and update the runbook: https://handbook.redwood.co/launches/cloudscale-runbook — include contact numbers and escalation ladder.
Mike Chen: Calendar invite sent and runbook updated with phone tree + escalation matrix.
LaunchBot: Automated reminder scheduled: "Pre-launch health check" at 07:15 UTC on launch day -> #ops-bridge
Ana Rivera: Any legal or compliance blockers on embargo language?
Julie Park: Legal cleared the embargo wording yesterday; I'll CC them on the publish thread for visibility.
CloudScale - Priya: Partner checklist complete except quote. We'll be available during 08:30-10:30 UTC for last-minute verification.
Mike Chen: Consolidated action list:
- Julie: finalize blog + embed partner quote (by EOD)
- Mike: calendar + runbook updates (today)
- Tom: infra pre-provision + CDN pre-warm (day-of morning)
- Sree: add rollback snippet to runbook (today)
- Priya: deliver partner quote (by 17:00 PT)
Ana Rivera: I'll post a final "launch readiness: go/no-go" at 06:00 UTC day-of. If no objections we proceed. :rocket:
